info.name: Lukka Pricing & Market Data Market Data - Downloadable Data (CSV) Market Data - Downloadable Data (CSV) API

items.docs:
This endpoint returns the past 3 days of historical market data requests. Append the request id to the end of the url and a pre-signed URL is returned allowing you to download the data set.

 URL should follow the below format:

 https://data-pricing-api.lukka.tech/v1/{productType}/requests/ 

 Available Product Types: quotes, trades

This endpoint allows users to post a request to obtain historical market data. Use the returned request id to obtain a pre-signed url allowing you to do download the results.

 URL should follow the below format:

 https://data-pricing-api.lukka.tech/v1/{productType}/historical/requests 

 Available Product Types: quotes, trades
